tests.scope: Synthetic offline grader tests, including all 180 cohort/case/trial envelopes and fixed threshold arithmetic. No live model/API, no physical-host exercise.

review_fix_chain.discovery: Pre-freeze independent static review; no executable red run or immutable initial hash was captured. Author confirmed and fixed before final freeze.
review_fix_chain.problem: A wrong dependency evidence kind was a common-grade failure but absent from the integrity marker set; it could count as an ordinary optional business failure within the 58/72 tolerance.
review_fix_chain.resolution: Final grade explicitly classifies invalid dependency evidence kind as evidence_integrity_failed; aggregate rejects this globally.

review_fix_chain.discovery: Pre-freeze independent static review; author confirmed and fixed before final freeze.
review_fix_chain.problem: A known business failure plus missing sampling/dependency/native evidence was collapsed to failed and counted as completed, allowing missing evidence to disappear behind a tolerable failure.
review_fix_chain.resolution: grade records evidence_complete before the unconditional draft pending item. aggregate counts incomplete evidence as pending while retaining original failures for security, role, permission and mandatory-case hard gates.

confirmed_design.suite_hash_semantics: _SuiteToken has no filesystem protocol. Only the exact internal token gets the effective suite digest; all actual Paths, including real cases-v1.json evidence, retain their byte SHA256.
confirmed_design.v1_engine_isolation: Pinned unmodified grade/template/aggregate function code runs with independently copied globals and explicit suite/digest/DOCS overrides. Imported original globals are not patched; effective dataset version is never rewritten to v1.
confirmed_design.scope_and_integrity: Only the fixed development suite is accepted. Contract/schema/code pins, original evidence bytes, duplicate identity/nonce/trial, malformed versions and overlays are checked; aggregate reopens original run paths instead of accepting supplied verdicts.
confirmed_design.registration: Role proof binding includes run/nonce/version/case/cohort/trial/effective-case/overlay; source documents and original model/tool dispatch audit bind task ID, registration file byte hash and timezone-aware chronology. Missing collection-time provenance stays pending; header metadata alone cannot retrospectively register an old sample.
confirmed_design.runtime_identity: Actual runtime owner/node/tool-store declarations, independently sourced authenticated runtime observations, AgentStore path/key/decrypted task readback, exact source ownership deployment and authorized connector/history deployment are required within the trusted collector/reviewer boundary. These are not remote attestation.
confirmed_design.reference: Queued accounting task/store is separately labeled. Reference also requires an independently read native-session artifact and native request IDs matching original model request IDs exactly; existence/hash/boolean alone is insufficient.
confirmed_design.physical_hosts: Cases requiring two hosts require distinct observed host identities with collector probes bound to run nonce and node identities. Logical nodes alone cannot complete this gate.
confirmed_design.thresholds: Pinned common assertion/aggregation code preserves 72 candidate business trials, 18 permission trials, mandatory three-repeat gates, absolute 58/72 and 80% of complete reference business results. Security/role/integrity failures remain hard failures. Missing reference data never establishes the relative gate.
confirmed_design.draft: Schema rejects formal registration and non-draft status. grade and aggregate always formal_pass=false; fully evidenced synthetic diagnostic success remains status pending. No formal activation, normalization of real samples, or old-run regrading as fresh samples is implemented by this review.

limitations: No held-out data, generator/build_cases, live model, remote host or production/controller edits accessed or performed.
Synthetic test documents deliberately fabricate collector facts and do not constitute actual model execution, identity, native-session or two-host acceptance evidence.

Trusted collectors and independent reviewers still establish observation authenticity and completeness. Hashes/bindings detect inconsistency and drift; they cannot make fabricated but internally consistent evidence true.
Only the final grader/schema/tests snapshot was executed independently. Intermediate static findings are retained without inventing a red-test execution or an unavailable pre-fix hash.
Existing raw development runs that lack new original dispatch provenance must remain pending; do not backfill missing original evidence from final metadata.
No formal score, 80% performance conclusion or business-task success claim follows from these 72 passing software tests.
